title: Soda Scan Check Failures
dataSources: Monte Carlo incident webhooks (`montecarlo:incident`), Great Expectations `validation_result` JSON (`great_expectations:validation`), Soda scan results (`soda:scan`), dbt test failures, warehouse `INFORMATION_SCHEMA` freshness/volume probes via DB Connect.
app: Monte Carlo / Bigeye / Soda webhooks and REST APIs via HEC; Great Expectations and dbt test results via HEC scripted inputs; custom warehouse data-quality probes via Splunk DB Connect.
spl:
index=dataops sourcetype=soda:scan
| stats sum(checks_evaluated) as checks, sum(checks_failed) as failures by dataset, scan_definition
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Tracks Soda scan results and flags datasets with failing checks so declarative data-quality tests are enforced operationally.
value: Soda checks encode business rules about data; surfacing failures ensures those rules actually gate the data reaching dashboards.
implementation: Send Soda scan results to HEC; schedule after scans; alert on failures for critical datasets.
visualization: Table of failing checks by dataset, timechart of failures.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the plain-language data-quality checks your team defined and flag when the data does not meet them.
